newsitem.title: USA: FOB Gulf Grain - Nearby corn up as Egypt buys.
newsitem.headline: FOB Gulf Grain - Nearby corn up as Egypt buys.

text.p: Nearby FOB Gulf corn basis values were higher while soybean and wheat prices were steady on Wednesday as Egypt bought 500,000 tonnes U.S. corn, export sources said.

Traders noted some strength in nearby corn values, reflecting the increased corn export demand, but one exporter said he was not surprised by USDA's announcement Wednesday morning of the corn sale, noting the country typically imports three to five times that much in a year.
The trader speculated the sale could include some optional origin barley or feed wheat.

"I wouldn't be surprised if someone sold them optional origin and they just registered it as U.S. corn," the broker said. "Looking at the world prices, wouldn't you want to sell them barley and feed wheat options?
"Granted, they usually buy corn, but what's to preclude them from taking one or two cargoes" of barley or wheat.
